name: boctulus/simplerest-cli
description: General-purpose php com command groups and the `simplerest init` application bootstrap for SimpleRest projects

suggest.boctulus/simplerest-scaffolding: Required by `migrations make` and `migrations migrate --make` to generate migration, schema and model files
suggest.boctulus/simplerest-jwt-auth: Provides AuthController, which the generated app/Controllers/MyAuthController extends; required for API requests
